answers.core: This is a change for a core functionality/part of a core setting. Also this seems such a small change that an add-on would be overkill.
answers.workaround: Currently you can check if your templates are part of the folder defined in the "editor/script/templates_search_path" in the _enter_tree method of your plugin and if they are not then your can copy them over via script.

title: Let "Templates Search Path" accept multiple paths
